name: Update Vendor

pathParams.name: vendorId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the vendor to update

attributes.name: TaxpayerName
attributes.description: The taxpayer name of the vendor. If UseCompanyNameAsTaxpayerName is true, then TaxpayerName will be CompanyName. If IsCompany is true, and TaxpayerName is not provided, then TaxpayerName will be set to CompanyName. If IsCompany is false, and TaxpayerName is not provided, then TaxpayerName will be set to the concatenation of FirstName and LastName. If TaxpayerName is provided, and UseCompanyNameAsTaxpayerName is false, then TaxpayerName will be set as provided value.

attributes.name: TaxpayerId
attributes.description: The tax identification number of the vendor. This field accepts either a Employer Identification Number (EIN), a Social Security Number (SSN), or an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN).

attributes.name: CompanyName
attributes.description: The display name of the vendor's company

attributes.name: Send1099
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the vendor needs a 1099 tax form from the management company

attributes.name: FirstName
attributes.description: The vendor's first name

attributes.name: LastName
attributes.description: The vendor's last name

attributes.name: Address1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the vendor. If provided, City, State, and Zip must also be provided.

attributes.name: Address2
attributes.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the vendor. If provided, Address1, City, State, and Zip must also be provided.

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: The city where the vendor is located. If provided, Address1, State, and Zip must also be provided.

attributes.name: State
attributes.description: The state where the vendor is located (e.g. "CA" for California). If provided, Address1, City, and Zip must also be provided. This value must not be an unincorporated US territory (AS, FM, MH, MP, or VI) for primary address when the vendor is using online payables with ACH.

attributes.name: Zip
attributes.description: The zip code where the vendor is located. Must be a string in 5-digit ZIP code format (e.g., 93013) or ZIP+4 format (e.g., 93013-0429). If provided, Address1, City, and State must also be provided.

attributes.name: CountryCode
attributes.description: The country code of the vendor (e.g. "JP" for Japan). If provided, Address1, City, State, and Zip must also be provided. This value must be US for primary address when the vendor is using online payables and ACH.

attributes.name: PhoneNumber
attributes.description: The vendor's primary phone number

attributes.name: PhoneNumbers
attributes.description: The vendor's phone number(s). PhoneNumber and PhoneNumbers cannot be provided together. Passing any number of phone numbers will replace all existing phone numbers for the vendor.

attributes.name: Number
attributes.description: The vendor's phone number

attributes.name: AdditionalDetails
attributes.description: Additional detailed information pertaining to the phone number associated with the vendor

attributes.name: IsPrimary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the phone number provided is the vendor's main contact number

attributes.name: Label
attributes.description: The label of the phone number, e.g. 'Home'

attributes.name: Email
attributes.description: The vendor's primary email address

attributes.name: Emails
attributes.description: The vendor's email address(es). Email and Emails cannot be provided together. Passing any number of emails will replace all existing email addresses for the vendor.

attributes.name: EmailAddress
attributes.description: The vendor's email address

attributes.name: IsPrimary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the email address provided is the vendor's primary email address

attributes.name: CompanyURL
attributes.description: The internet address of vendor's website

attributes.name: LiabilityInsuranceExpiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the vendor's liability insurance. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) is required. Legacy MM/DD/YYYY format is supported for backward compatibility but will be deprecated in a future release.

attributes.name: AutoInsuranceExpiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the vendor's automobile insurance. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) is required. Legacy MM/DD/YYYY format is supported for backward compatibility but will be deprecated in a future release.

attributes.name: WorkersCompExpiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the vendor's worker's compensation insurance. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) is required. Legacy MM/DD/YYYY format is supported for backward compatibility but will be deprecated in a future release.

attributes.name: ContractExpiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the contract. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) is required. Legacy MM/DD/YYYY format is supported for backward compatibility but will be deprecated in a future release.

attributes.name: UmbrellaInsuranceExpiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the vendor's umbrella insurance. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) is required. Legacy MM/DD/YYYY format is supported for backward compatibility but will be deprecated in a future release.

attributes.name: CompliantStatus
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the vendor meets compliance

attributes.name: NetVendorId
attributes.description: The vendor's NetVendor ID

attributes.name: IsCompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the vendor identifies as a company

attributes.name: UseCompanyNameAsTaxpayerName
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not to use the company name for tax paying purposes

attributes.name: DefaultAutoAcceptWorkOrders
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is ineligible for auto-accept work order assignments. When set to true, this vendor will auto-accept all work orders assigned to them.

attributes.name: PaymentTerms
attributes.description: Represents the number of days the payment is due after the invoice date. A null value indicates that no payment terms were defined. A value of 0 indicates the payment is due on receipt. A value greater than 0, for example, 15, indicates the payment is due 15 days after the invoice date. Required if UsingEomTerms is true.

attributes.name: UsingEomTerms
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the payment terms include an end-of-month (EOM) stipulation. For example, if PaymentTerms is 15, and EOM is true, the payment is due within 15 days of the end of the month.

attributes.name: Tags
attributes.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the vendor. Providing an array of valid strings will overwrite all existing tags. Passing in an empty array [] or an array of empty strings will clear all existing tags. Passing in null will result in no change.

attributes.name: CustomFields
attributes.description: The custom fields for the associated entity. The value of the CustomField to update keyed by CustomFieldId. To clear the value of a CustomField, set CustomFieldId to null. For array-type custom fields (select_multiple), use an empty array [] or empty string instead of null.

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated vendor
